papers.authors: K. S. Sreeramji, Sabyasachi Basu, Ravishankar Krishnaswamy, Kirankumar Shiragur, Yujia Wang
papers.evidence: 直接研究标量量化与乘积量化的非均匀比特分配，支持极低比特SQ
papers.tldr: 随着模型规模增大，嵌入向量占用大量存储，量化成为关键压缩手段。传统量化方法通常忽略嵌入的几何结构，在维度间均匀分配比特，导致低比特下效率低下。本文提出一种可变比特分配框架，将嵌入划分为连续桶，并采用贪心策略为非均匀分配存储。在具有Matryoshka性质的嵌入上，该方法在相同存储预算下显著优于均匀量化，PQ和SQ的召回率分别提升8%和18%，为结构感知的检索压缩提供了新思路。
papers.abstract_en: Quantization is a fundamental technique to handle the growing sizes of embeddings generated by modern models. Existing quantization schemes are largely embedding agnostic and allocate bits uniformly across dimensions. However, recent models produce embeddings with significant geometric structure. In this work, we investigate whether a variable bit allocation scheme can improve quantization quality under a fixed memory budget. We propose a simple variable bit allocation framework that partitions an embedding into contiguous buckets and allocates storage non-uniformly across them. Using a greedy allocation strategy, we instantiate this framework for both Product Quantization (PQ) and Scalar Quantization (SQ). We perform a series of experiments on embeddings known to have the Matryoshka property (MRL), and consistently observe that non-uniform allocations outperform uniform baselines at identical storage budgets. The largest improvements occur in the low-bit regime, where uniform allocation is particularly inefficient for MRL embeddings. At the same compression rates, variable allocation improves recall by up to 8\% for PQ and up to 18\% for SQ. Our results suggest a new direction for structure-aware compression and indexing techniques for large-scale retrieval systems.

papers.title_en: Activation-Weighted Seeded Residual Coding for Low-Bit LLM Weight Repair
papers.authors: Zehao Liu, Chuangchuang Fang, Yang Ren
papers.evidence: 低位权重复原残差编码，激活加权，Qwen先进结果
papers.tldr: 低位权重量化虽节省存储却引入误差，损害语言模型质量。为此提出AWSRC，一种基于种子生成残差基的紧凑修复编解码器，通过激活统计优先修复影响输出大的误差，sidecar仅存种子选择器与低比特系数。在Qwen2.5-3B上，为INT4骨干添加0.162比特/权重即可缩小与BF16差距的88%以上，且优于稀疏、低秩等编解码器。
papers.abstract_en: Low-bit weight quantization saves storage but leaves errors that degrade language-model quality. We introduce Activation-Weighted Seeded Residual Coding (AWSRC), a compact repair codec for an existing quantization backbone. Given a reconstructed weight $W_0$, AWSRC encodes the residual $W-W_0$ using deterministic seed-generated bases. The sidecar stores seed selectors, low-bit coefficients, and scales rather than an explicit codebook. Activation statistics prioritize errors that affect layer outputs. On Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, adding 0.162 scope-bits/weight to an INT4 RTN backbone closes 88.2%, 78.9%, and 71.3% of the matched PPL, KL, and accuracy gaps to BF16. Repairing a matched strong low-bit backbone also improves all measured quality metrics. With a matched 49.25 MB sidecar, about 0.8% of the BF16 model-weight payload, AWSRC gives the best perplexity and mean task accuracy among sparse, low-rank, and vector-quantized codecs.

papers.title_en: Jacobian-guided Noise Injection for Quantization Robustness in Large Language Models
papers.authors: Deepanshu Pandey, Arnav Chavan, Nahush Lele, Sankalp Dayal, Deepak Gupta
papers.evidence: LLM量化鲁棒性，softmax瓶颈，先进训练策略
papers.tldr: 量化大型语言模型常因自注意力机制对离散化误差敏感而受阻，其中softmax算子因其对异常值和状态相关雅可比矩阵的敏感性成为量化稳定性的瓶颈。本文从理论上证明抑制该雅可比矩阵范数有助于界定量化引起的性能下降，并据此提出雅可比引导噪声注入训练策略，在注意力前对数中注入由雅可比Frobenius范数导出的零均值高斯噪声。该方法在主流PTQ方法上展现出更优鲁棒性，在SigLIP的ImageNet-1K Top-1准确率和语言模型的WikiText困惑度上分别获得高达37%和40%的相对提升。
papers.abstract_en: Quantization of Large Language Models (LLMs) is often hindered by the sensitivity of the self-attention mechanism to discretization errors. We identify the softmax operator as a bottleneck for quantization stability due to its sensitivity to outliers and state-dependent Jacobian. We theoretically establish that suppressing the norm of this Jacobian helps in bounding quantization-induced performance degradation. Based on this, we propose Jacobian-Guided Noise Injection, a training strategy that injects zero-mean Gaussian noise into pre-attention logits, with variance derived directly from the Jacobian Frobenius norm. Unlike prior approaches that rely on heuristic or penalise jacobian directly, our method provides a way to identify the optimal noise variance based on the local attention sensitivity. We evaluate the method on SOTA LLM architectures, where it demonstrates improved robustness over popular PTQ methods. Empirical analysis reveals that the proposed method gives up to +37% relative gains on Top-1 accuracy on ImageNet-1K for SigLIP and improves relative perplexity by upto 40% on WikiText for language models in low bit quantisation settings, proving the efficacy of the approach.

papers.title_en: Two-Level Decorrelated Coded Modulation on the $D_4$ Lattice
papers.authors: Leopold Bertholet, Chloe Makdad, Stephen Mackes, Daniel Chew, Matthew Robinson
papers.evidence: 基于 D4 格的编码调制，与格向量量化相关
papers.tldr: 针对D4格子上编码调制的整形增益与低复杂度折衷问题，我们提出两级去相关编码(TLDC)方案。该方案结合Voronoi整形与两级译码，第一级译码后的值使第二级各随机变量近似不相关，从而支持并行译码或合并为更大的码字。在16-QAM AWGN信道下，块长为64和1024比特时，该方案相比现有先进编码调制获得最高0.5dB的额外增益。TLDC支持每级灵活选择FEC，以低复杂度实现整形与编码增益。
papers.abstract_en: We propose \textit{two-level decorrelated coding} (TLDC), a novel coded modulation scheme for the $D_4$ lattice that combines Voronoi shaping with a two-stage decoding process to achieve lattice shaping and coding gains at low complexity. In TLDC, the decoded values of the first level allow the several random variables in the second level to become approximately uncorrelated. The resulting independence of the variables in level two permits decoding in parallel or consolidation into a larger codeword, enhancing performance. TLDC supports flexible choice of FEC within each level. Using bit-interleaved or multi-level polar codes at each level, the resulting coded modulation scheme exhibits a gain of up to 0.5 dB over analogous state-of-the-art coded modulation schemes on a 16-QAM under AWGN at block sizes of 64 and 1024 bits.
